description: Scores every fact against the knowledge-base synonym index (DE/EN), unit and type checks and the attribute range, and returns candidate mappings sorted by confidence with a DE/EN explanation and provenance. Review proposals under 0.7 with the user or the source page, then pass the accepted ones to apply_mappings. Ask for detail "full", or pass attributeIds, to see every candidate with its file, page and cell in the text.

attributeIds.description: Keep only proposals for these attribute ids; unknown ids are reported, not an error. When given, the text lists every match, not just the first 10, with provenance, even in summary mode

detail.description: summary (default): header line plus the first 10 proposals, no provenance. full: every proposal after the filters, one line each, with provenance (file, page, cell); no cap

facts.description: A FactSet object, or { factSetId } as returned by extract_facts

lang.description: Language of the text summary (default en)

minConfidence.description: Drop proposals below this confidence (default 0). 0.7 is the review threshold

name: suggest_mappings
title: Suggest attribute mappings
